eos.employer: Ended by the employer, or the contract expired
eos.fullResignationHint: Force majeure, or a female worker within 6 months of marriage or 3 months of giving birth.
eos.wageSaHint: Basic wage plus housing, transport and other allowances due.
eos.wageAeHint: Basic salary only, without housing or transport allowance.
eos.firstPart: Half a month per year for the first 5 years
eos.restPart: A full month per year after that
eos.capped: The award has reached the maximum: 2 years' wage.
eos.lessThanYear: No gratuity is due before completing one year of service.
eos.lessThanTwo: No award is due if you resign before completing 2 years.
eos.noneArt80: No award is due on dismissal under Article 80 of the Labor Law.
eos.disclaimerSa: Estimate under Articles 84, 85 and 87 of the Saudi Labor Law. The award must be paid within a week if the employer ended the contract, and within two weeks if the worker resigned.
eos.disclaimerAe: Estimate under Article 51 of Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021. Dues must be paid within 14 days of the end of employment.

consent.text: Necessary cookies remember your theme, your language and this choice. With your permission, Google also uses cookies to measure visits and personalise ads. You can change your choice at any time from the bottom of the page.

consent.analyticsDesc: Help us see which tools are used most (Google Analytics).
consent.adsDesc: Lets Google show ads based on your interests. If you reject it, you'll see non-personalised ads.
